summary_en: By decree of 25 January 2019, at the mandate of Pope Francis, the celebration of St Paul VI, pope, is inscribed in the General Roman Calendar on 29 May with the rank of optional memorial; the annexed Additiones give the Calendar line, the Missal collect (Common of pastors: for a pope), the Lectionary references (n. 571a), the Liturgy of the Hours texts and a new first-place elogium for the Roman Martyrology on 29 May. The decree is printed in Latin, English, French, German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese.
excerpt: Summus Pontifex FRANCISCUS, postulationes et desideria populi Dei annuens, celebrationem sancti Pauli VI, papæ, die 29 maii, gradu memoriæ ad libitum, in Calendarium Romanum inseri decrevit.

summary_en: By decree of 7 October 2019, at the mandate of Pope Francis, the optional memorial of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Loreto is inscribed in the General Roman Calendar on 10 December, to be celebrated every year; the annexed Additiones give the Calendar line, the Missal collect (Common of the BVM), the Lectionary references (n. 689 bis), the Liturgy of the Hours texts and a new first-place elogium for the Roman Martyrology on 10 December. The decree is printed in Latin, English, French, Spanish and Italian.
excerpt: Summus Pontifex FRANCISCUS decrevit memoriam ad libitum Beatæ Mariæ Virginis de Loreto in Calendarium Romanum inscribendam esse die 10 decembris, die etenim quo Laureti festum agitur, et quotannis celebrandam.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Alfonsus Pacheco, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: Blessed Alfonso Pacheco, priest and martyr, is confirmed as patron of the missionaries of Albacete, diocese of Albacete (Spain); a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Beatus Alfonsus Pacheco, presbyter et martyr: Patronus apud Deum missionariorum albasitensium, Albasitensis, Hispania (6 nov. 2019; Prot. 511/19).

summary_en: Blessed Anacleto González Flores, martyr, is confirmed as patron of the laity of Mexico; a patron of a category of persons at national level.
excerpt: Beatus Anacletus González Flores, martyr: Patronus apud Deum laicorum Mexici (11 iun. 2019; Prot. 454/17).

summary_en: St Barbara, virgin and martyr, is confirmed as patroness of the town of Libiąż, archdiocese of Kraków (Poland); a single-town patron.
excerpt: Sancta Barbara, virgo et martyr: Patrona apud Deum urbis v.d. Libiąż, Cracoviensis, Polonia (22 oct. 2019; Prot. 361/19).

summary_en: St Elizabeth of Hungary is confirmed as patroness of the city of Košice, archdiocese of Košice (Slovakia); a single-city patron.
excerpt: Sancta Elisabeth Hungariae: Patrona apud Deum Cassoviae, Cassoviensis, Slovacia (18 oct. 2019; Prot. 254/19).

summary_en: St Maria Domenica Mazzarello, virgin, is confirmed as secondary patroness of the town of Mornese, diocese of Acqui (Italy); a single-town patron (the line prints 'virginis').
excerpt: Sancta Maria Dominica Mazzarello, virginis: Patrona secundaria apud Deum civitatis v.d. Mornese, Aquensis, Italia (24 maii 2019; Prot. 266/19).

target.institute: Ordinis Praedicatorum (provincia Bohemiae)

summary_en: St Zdislava, mother of a family, is confirmed as patroness of the Bohemian province of the Order of Preachers (a province of an institute, not the whole Order).
excerpt: Sancta Zdislava, materfamilias: Patrona apud Deum provinciae Bohemiae Ordinis Praedicatorum (2 maii 2019; Prot. 461/18).

summary_en: St Boniface, bishop and martyr, is confirmed as patron of the town of San Bonifacio, diocese of Vicenza (Italy); a single-town patron (the line prints 'martyris').
excerpt: Sanctus Bonifatius, episcopus et martyris: Patronus apud Deum civitatis Sancti Bonifatii, Vicentinae, Italia (10 apr. 2019; Prot. 555/18).

summary_en: St Gabriel of Our Lady of Sorrows is confirmed as secondary patron of the city of Civitanova Marche (Cluana), archdiocese of Fermo (Italy); a single-city patron.
excerpt: Sanctus Gabriel a Virgine Perdolenti: Patronus secundarius apud Deum civitatis Cluanae, Firmanae, Italia (6 aug. 2019; Prot. 381/19).

summary_en: St John Paul II, pope, is confirmed as patron of the federation 'Federación mundial de las obras eucarísticas de la Iglesia' (World Federation of the Eucharistic Works of the Church); an association's patron, no nation.
excerpt: Sanctus Ioannes Paulus II, papa: Patronus apud Deum Foederationis v.d. Federación mundial de las obras eucarísticas de la Iglesia (2 apr. 2019; Prot. 239/18).

summary_en: St Lawrence, deacon and martyr, and St Francis of Assisi are confirmed as principal and secondary patrons respectively of the city of Cairo Montenotte, diocese of Acqui (Italy); two celebrations in one decree, single-city patrons.
excerpt: Sanctus Laurentius, diaconus et martyr, et Sanctus Franciscus Assisiensis: Patronus principalis et secundarius apud Deum civitatis v.d. Cairo Montenotte, Aquensis, Italia (11 iun. 2019; Prot. 264/19).

summary_en: St Nicholas, bishop, is confirmed as patron of the town of Mrocza, diocese of Bydgoszcz (Poland); a single-town patron.
excerpt: Sanctus Nicolaus, episcopus: Patronus apud Deum urbis v.d. Mrocza, Bydgostiensis, Polonia (18 iun. 2019; Prot. 376/18).

summary_en: St Peter, apostle, is confirmed as patron of the municipality of Barberino Tavarnelle, archdiocese of Florence (Italy); a single-place patron.
excerpt: Sanctus Petrus, apostolus: Patronus apud Deum pagi v.d. Barberino Tavarnelle, Florentinae, Italia (14 sep. 2019; Prot. 365/19).

summary_en: St Roch is confirmed as patron of the town and commune of Zator, archdiocese of Kraków (Poland); a single-town patron.
excerpt: Sanctus Rochus: Patronus apud Deum urbis et communis v.d. Zator, Cracoviensis, Polonia (3 maii 2019; Prot. 100/18).

summary_en: St Roch is confirmed as patron of the town of Kazimierza Wielka, diocese of Kielce (Poland; printed 'Kilcensis'); a single-town patron.
excerpt: Sanctus Rochus: Patronus apud Deum urbis v.d. Kazimierza Wielka, Kilcensis, Polonia (27 aug. 2019; Prot. 535/18).
